1. 열왕기하는 예레미야의 저작?\n - 열왕기하 24~25장은 예레미야:
1. Was 2 Kings written by Jeremiah?
 - 2 Kings 24~25 is exactly the same as Jeremiah 52. That means the author is very likely the same. Why? Because Jeremiah's name never shows up in 2 Kings. If someone else had written 2 Kings, there's no way they could leave out Jeremiah's name, but it's missing.  The idea is that maybe Jeremiah had already written plenty about himself in the book of Jeremiah, so he left himself out of the history book. Also, at that time, besides Jeremiah, there was probably nobody who could write history like this, with such great insight.
2. 무지와 고집과 오해와 편견은 망하는 길\n - 시드기야처럼 무지와:
2. Ignorance, stubbornness, misunderstanding and prejudice are the road to ruin
 - When you have ignorance, stubbornness, misunderstanding and prejudice like Zedekiah, even when someone is speaking the right truth, you just can't hear it.
그 시대 사람들의 무지와 고집과 오해와 편견 때문에 예레미야의 말은 끝내: Because of the ignorance, stubbornness, misunderstanding and prejudice of the people of that time, Jeremiah's words never got through to people's ears in the end.
그 끔찍한 결과가 예레미냐 애가에 나타나 있습니다. 애가로~: That horrible result shows up in Lamentations. On to Lamentations~
